title: Bioprocess Atlas: comparable perturbation effects from published bioreactor runs
description:
The Bioprocess Atlas collects real fermentation and cell-culture time courses from published studies, changed one factor at a time, and reduces them to the same set of phenotypes, so that the effect of a gene, a temperature, a feed or a medium can be compared across labs, organisms and scales.

Release v0.3 holds 7 measured datasets, 146 bioreactor runs, 6 organisms (Escherichia coli, Bacillus subtilis, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, Saccharomyces pastorianus, Komagataella phaffii and CHO), 220,453 observations and 45 one-factor comparisons.

Five tables are rebuilt from the unchanged published files with one command, and each release carries a manifest with the schema version, the analysis engine version and a checksum of every observation: runs, observations, phenotypes, effects (each perturbation against its own reference, with Welch t-test and effect size) and contrasts.

Each source dataset keeps the licence of its original publication (CC BY 4.0 or CC0) and is credited in data/raw/<dataset>/README.md and in release/datasets.csv; please cite the original studies alongside this release. The code in atlas/ is MIT licensed.

An interactive explainer is published at https://anupama29k.github.io/Bioprocess-Atlas/
